{{Quote|Lommite Limited and InterGalactic Ore have merged to become Dorvalla Mining, but the Trade Federation will transport the ore, and will now represent Dorvalla in the Galactic Senate.|[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]|<ref name="DMS" />}}
'''Dorvalla''' was a [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world, located in the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]], controlled by [[Dorvalla Mining]] and initially independent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> it was the scene of a [[Dorvalla Incident|battle]] between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. Subsequently, it was taken over by the Trade Federation.<ref name="CoD" />

Initially, there were two main mining companies: [[Lommite Limited]] and [[InterGalactic Ore]]. However, they sabotaged each other to near bankruptcy and they fused together and fell into the hands of the Trade Federation.<ref name="DMS" />

Originally a temperate world, the mining operations turned Dorvalla into a world covered with lommite dust. From space, Dorvalla seemed to have a thick band of perpetual clouds. In the rainy season, the dust turned to thick mud, making surface travel nearly impossible.

Few people lived on the planet, but those who did were almost always involved in the [[Ore/Legends|ore]] industry.

This planet was located near the systems of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. It was orbited by a single moon.

The strike team of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] had a [[Arwen Cohl's base|base]] of operations here for their raid on the Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class freighter]] ''[[Revenue]]''.<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' placed Dorvalla as the recently established capital of the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]]. However, the later sources ''[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]'' and [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] placed it in the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]]. Furthermore, ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' stated that Dorvalla lay between the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. Leland Chee has confirmed that for the time being, the original placement in the Cadavine sector is incorrect, and the latter placement is considered [[canon]].<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=30#3929926|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-05-28|time=9:28 AM|quote=For the time being, we are disregarding the placement of Dorvalla in the Cadavine sector as described in the Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook (which also misspelled "Zhar" as "Zahr.") As far as I know, there are no intentions to expand upon whether a second Dorvalla exists or not.}}</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' the planet is misspelled as Dorvalia.
